  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares


def calibrate_creep_inputs(
    past_command: np.ndarray, hold_command: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray,
    strata: np.ndarray, raw_features: np.ndarray, reference_panel: np.ndarray,
    check_groups: np.ndarray, check_command: np.ndarray, check_stress: np.ndarray,
    yield_stress: float, *, affine_priors: dict | None = None,
    calibration_residual_fraction: float = 1e-6,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return calibrated history and hold stress, aligned features, and missing mask.

    Each group has a positive affine load-cell response and one shared positive
    affine feature gauge. Use pairwise median slopes (minimum command separation
    8% of span), then refit after a 4.5 median-absolute-residual trim with a
    floor expressed as a fraction of yield stress. Without command leverage,
    keep the supplied group prior gain (default one) and estimate the offset
    from any available checks; without checks, use the full prior (default
    identity). Prior offsets are in the same stress units as check_stress.
    Each nonempty group-stratum cell gets one vote per observed feature.
    All supplied rows inform feature alignment, but no response data enter it.
    """
    if yield_stress <= 0 or calibration_residual_fraction < 0:
        raise ValueError('invalid yield stress or calibration residual floor')
    groups, strata, cg = map(np.asarray, (groups, strata, check_groups))
    cx = np.asarray(check_command, float) / yield_stress
    cy = np.asarray(check_stress, float) / yield_stress
    panel = np.asarray(reference_panel, float)
    raw = np.asarray(raw_features, float)
    missing = ~np.isfinite(raw)
    aligned = np.full_like(raw, np.nan)
    past = np.empty_like(past_command, dtype=float)
    hold = np.empty_like(hold_command, dtype=float)
    pc, hc = np.asarray(past_command, float), np.asarray(hold_command, float)
    cells = []
    for g in np.unique(groups):
        rows = groups == g
        checks = (cg == g) & np.isfinite(cx) & np.isfinite(cy)
        x, y = cx[checks], cy[checks]
        gain, bias = (affine_priors or {}).get(g, (1.0, 0.0))
        bias /= yield_stress
        if x.size:
            i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
            dx = x[i] - x[j]
            good = np.abs(dx) > 0.08 * np.ptp(x)
            if np.any(good):
                gain = np.median((y[i[good]] - y[j[good]]) / dx[good])
            bias = np.median(y - gain * x)
            if np.any(good):
                err = np.abs(y - gain * x - bias)
                keep = err <= max(calibration_residual_fraction, 4.5 * np.median(err))
                if keep.sum() >= 2 and np.ptp(x[keep]) > 0:
                    x0, span = np.mean(x[keep]), np.ptp(x[keep])
                    a, b = np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack(((x[keep] - x0) / span,
                                                            np.ones(keep.sum()))),
                                           y[keep], rcond=None)[0]
                    gain, bias = a / span, b - a / span * x0
        if not np.isfinite(gain) or gain <= 0:
            raise ValueError('nonpositive or nonfinite load-cell gain')
        past[rows] = gain * pc[rows] + bias * yield_stress
        hold[rows] = gain * hc[rows] + bias * yield_stress
        p = np.where(np.isfinite(panel[rows]), panel[rows], np.nan)
        p = p[:, np.isfinite(p).sum(axis=0) > 1]
        widths = np.nanstd(p, axis=0)
        if not np.any(widths > 0):
            raise ValueError('group reference panel has no positive scale')
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(p, axis=0))
        aligned[rows] = (raw[rows] - center) / np.median(widths[widths > 0])
        for s in np.unique(strata[rows]):
            cell = aligned[rows & (strata == s)]
            valid = np.isfinite(cell)
            count = valid.sum(axis=0)
            cells.append(np.divide(np.where(valid, cell, 0.0).sum(axis=0), count,
                                   out=np.full(raw.shape[1], np.nan), where=count > 0))
    cells = np.asarray(cells)
    if np.any(~np.isfinite(cells).any(axis=0)):
        raise ValueError('an aligned feature is unobserved in every cell')
    return past, hold, np.where(missing, np.nanmean(cells, axis=0), aligned), missing


def hereditary_creep_design(
    past_stress: np.ndarray, hold_stress: np.ndarray, history_durations: np.ndarray,
    hold_times: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, taus: np.ndarray,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return curve and onset designs plus the two branch log-tau derivatives.

    Use consistent stress and time units, piecewise-constant past stress in
    chronological order, zero initial branch states, and a sub-yield hold.
    Curve design excludes initial strain. Columns are two branch amplitudes,
    drift intercept, then drift features; derivative arrays contain only the
    derivative of each branch column with respect to its own log-tau.
    """
    past, hold, dt, t, x, taus = map(lambda a: np.asarray(a, float),
                                    (past_stress, hold_stress, history_durations,
                                     hold_times, features, taus))
    if taus.shape != (2,) or not np.all(taus > 0):
        raise ValueError('two positive time constants are required')
    after = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0] if dt.size else dt
    curve, rate, dcurve, drate = [], [], [], []
    for tau in taus:
        decay = np.exp(-after / tau)
        step = -np.expm1(-dt / tau)
        gap = hold - past @ (decay * step)
        dgap = -past @ (decay * ((after / tau) * step - (dt / tau) * np.exp(-dt / tau)))
        u = t / tau
        growth = -np.expm1(-u)
        curve.append(np.outer(gap, growth))
        rate.append(gap / tau)
        dcurve.append(np.outer(dgap, growth) - np.outer(gap, u * np.exp(-u)))
        drate.append((dgap - gap) / tau)
    f = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(hold)), x))
    return (np.concatenate((np.stack(curve, axis=-1), f[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None]), axis=-1),
            np.column_stack((*rate, f)), np.stack(dcurve, axis=-1), np.column_stack(drate))


def fit_predict_hereditary_creep(
    past_stress: np.ndarray, hold_stress: np.ndarray, history_durations: np.ndarray,
    hold_times: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, missing_features: np.ndarray,
    initial_strain: np.ndarray, observed_strain: np.ndarray, observed_onset: np.ndarray,
    fit_rows: np.ndarray, yield_stress: float, tau_bounds_fraction: tuple[float, float],
    strain_sd: float, onset_sd: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit shared taus and weights; return those and the non-fit curves and rates.

    The positive maximum hold time sets the time unit; yield stress sets the
    stress unit. All stresses must be strictly sub-yield. Supply bounds as
    fractions of the hold horizon and positive noise scales in strain and
    strain per input time unit. Fit with Cauchy loss and one per-channel MAD
    rescaling (factor 1.7, floor 1e-3 of the initial channel scale). No weight
    ridge is used: fail on unresolved branches or deficient joint sensitivity.
    Non-fit strain is never used. A finite non-fit onset updates only the
    aggregate drift of rows with a missing active feature.
    """
    p, h, dt, t, x, e0, obs, onset = map(lambda a: np.asarray(a, float),
        (past_stress, hold_stress, history_durations, hold_times, features,
         initial_strain, observed_strain, observed_onset))
    fit = np.asarray(fit_rows, bool)
    missing = np.asarray(missing_features, bool)
    horizon = float(np.max(t))
    lo, hi = tau_bounds_fraction
    if not (horizon > 0 and yield_stress > 0 and 0 < lo < hi and strain_sd > 0 and onset_sd > 0):
        raise ValueError('invalid physical scales, noise scales, or time bounds')
    if not (np.all(np.isfinite(dt) & (dt >= 0)) and np.all(np.isfinite(t) & (t >= 0))):
        raise ValueError('times must be finite and nonnegative')
    p, h, dt, t = p / yield_stress, h / yield_stress, dt / horizon, t / horizon
    if not (np.all(np.abs(p) < 1) and np.all(np.abs(h) < 1)):
        raise ValueError('history and hold must be strictly sub-yield')
    ef = obs[fit] - e0[fit, None]
    rf = onset[fit] * horizon
    cm, rm = np.isfinite(ef), np.isfinite(rf)
    nc = int(cm.sum())
    y = np.r_[ef[cm], rf[rm]]
    nw = 3 + x.shape[1]
    if nc == 0 or y.size < nw + 2:
        raise ValueError('insufficient finite observations for the joint design')
    pf, hf, xf = p[fit], h[fit], x[fit]
    scale = np.r_[np.full(nc, strain_sd), np.full(rm.sum(), onset_sd * horizon)]

    def design(log_tau: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        c, r, dc, dr = hereditary_creep_design(pf, hf, dt, t, xf, np.exp(log_tau))
        return np.vstack((c[cm], r[rm])), np.vstack((dc[cm], dr[rm]))

    seeds = []
    grid = np.linspace(np.log(lo), np.log(hi), 10)
    v = y / scale
    for i, a in enumerate(grid[:-1]):
        for b in grid[i + 1:]:
            A = design(np.array([a, b]))[0] / scale[:, None]
            w = np.ones_like(v)
            for _ in range(4):
                root = np.sqrt(w)
                co = np.linalg.lstsq(A * root[:, None], v * root, rcond=None)[0]
                residual = A @ co - v
                w = 1.0 / (1.0 + residual**2)
            seeds.append((np.log1p(residual**2).sum(), np.r_[a, b, co]))

    def refine(q0: np.ndarray, noise: np.ndarray):
        def residual(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
            return (design(q[:2])[0] @ q[2:] - y) / noise

        def jacobian(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
            A, D = design(q[:2])
            return np.column_stack((D * q[2:4], A)) / noise[:, None]

        return least_squares(residual, q0, jac=jacobian, loss='cauchy', x_scale='jac',
                             bounds=(np.r_[np.repeat(grid[0], 2), np.full(nw, -np.inf)],
                                     np.r_[np.repeat(grid[-1], 2), np.full(nw, np.inf)]),
                             max_nfev=200)

    best = min((refine(q, scale) for _, q in sorted(seeds, key=lambda s: s[0])[:3]),
               key=lambda result: result.cost)
    residual = best.fun * scale
    noise = scale.copy()
    for part in (slice(None, nc), slice(nc, None)):
        r = residual[part]
        if r.size:
            mad_scale = 1.7 * 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r)))
            noise[part] = np.maximum(1e-3 * scale[part], mad_scale)
    final = refine(best.x, noise)
    if not final.success:
        raise ValueError('robust creep fit did not converge')
    q = final.x
    A, D = design(q[:2])
    J = np.column_stack((D * q[2:4], A)) / noise[:, None]
    singular = np.linalg.svd(J / np.hypot(1.0, final.fun)[:, None], compute_uv=False)
    if abs(q[0] - q[1]) <= 1e-3 or singular[-1] <= 1e-8 * singular[0]:
        raise ValueError('two branches and drift are not jointly identifiable')
    order = np.argsort(q[:2])
    u = np.exp(q[:2][order])
    weights = np.r_[q[2:4][order], q[4:]]
    test = ~fit
    C, R, _, _ = hereditary_creep_design(p[test], h[test], dt, t, x[test], u)
    curve = C @ weights + e0[test, None]
    rate = R @ weights
    test_onset = onset[test] * horizon
    use = np.any(missing[test] & (weights[3:] != 0), axis=1) & np.isfinite(test_onset)
    curve[use] += (test_onset[use] - rate[use])[:, None] * t
    rate[use] = test_onset[use]
    physical_weights = weights / np.r_[np.repeat(yield_stress, 2), np.repeat(horizon, nw - 2)]
    return u * horizon, physical_weights, curve, rate / horizon

  "synthetic_unit_test_code": "import numpy as np


def run_self_test():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(8)
    n, k = 72, 34
    group, stratum = np.arange(n) % 4, np.arange(n) % 3
    fit = np.arange(n) < 60
    dt = np.array([0.16, 0.37, 0.52, 0.65])
    time = np.linspace(0.0, 4.0, k)
    past = rng.uniform(-1.4, 1.4, (n, dt.size))
    hold = rng.uniform(-1.4, 1.4, n)
    latent = rng.normal(size=(n, 4))
    latent[60:62, 0] = [3.0, -3.0]
    e0 = rng.normal(0.0, 0.02, n)
    taus = np.array([0.37, 1.90])
    weights = np.array([0.16, 0.11, 0.032, 0.040, -0.022, 0.013, 0.018])
    panel = rng.normal(size=(n, 4))
    for g in range(4):
        rows = group == g
        panel[rows] = (panel[rows] - panel[rows].mean(axis=0)) / panel[rows].std(axis=0)
    raw = latent.copy()
    raw[60:62, 0] = np.nan
    gain = np.array([0.88, 1.07, 1.18, 0.95])
    bias = np.array([0.10, -0.12, 0.17, -0.03])
    command_p = (past - bias[group, None]) / gain[group, None]
    command_h = (hold - bias[group]) / gain[group]
    cg = np.repeat(np.arange(4), 9)
    cx = np.tile(np.linspace(-1.7, 1.7, 9), 4)
    cy = gain[cg] * cx + bias[cg]
    cy[4::9] += 0.8

    drift = weights[2] + latent @ weights[3:]
    truth = e0[:, None] + drift[:, None] * time
    onset = drift.copy()
    for tau, amplitude in zip(taus, weights[:2]):
        z = np.zeros(n)
        for j, duration in enumerate(dt):
            decay = np.exp(-duration / tau)
            z = decay * z + (1.0 - decay) * past[:, j]
        truth += amplitude * (hold - z)[:, None] * (1.0 - np.exp(-time / tau))
        onset += amplitude * (hold - z) / tau
    C, R, DC, DR = hereditary_creep_design(past, hold, dt, time, latent, taus)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(C @ weights + e0[:, None], truth, atol=1e-13)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(R @ weights, onset, atol=1e-13)
    for j in range(2):
        shift = np.eye(2)[j] * 1e-5
        cp, rp, _, _ = hereditary_creep_design(past, hold, dt, time, latent, taus * np.exp(shift))
        cm, rm, _, _ = hereditary_creep_design(past, hold, dt, time, latent, taus * np.exp(-shift))
        np.testing.assert_allclose((cp[..., j] - cm[..., j]) / 2e-5, DC[..., j], atol=1e-9)
        np.testing.assert_allclose((rp[:, j] - rm[:, j]) / 2e-5, DR[:, j], atol=1e-9)

    obs = truth.copy()
    obs.flat[::13] += 0.22
    obs[~fit] = np.nan
    measured = onset.copy()
    measured[61] = np.nan
    measured[62] += 0.1
    a = np.array([1.2, 0.7, 2.3, 1.5])[group, None]
    b = np.array([4.0, -2.0, 3.0, 0.5])[group, None]
    p, h, x, missing = calibrate_creep_inputs(command_p, command_h, group, stratum,
        a * raw + b, a * panel + b, cg, cx, cy, 3.0)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(p, past, atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(h, hold, atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(x[~missing], latent[~missing], atol=1e-12)
    expected_fill = np.mean([np.nanmean(raw[(group == g) & (stratum == s), 0])
                             for g in range(4) for s in range(3)])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(x[60:62, 0], expected_fill, atol=1e-12)
    result = fit_predict_hereditary_creep(p, h, dt, time, x, missing, e0, obs, measured,
                                        fit, 3.0, (0.03, 1.5), 0.02, 0.015)
    tau, w, strain, rate = result
    assert all(np.all(np.isfinite(q)) for q in result)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(tau, taus, rtol=0.01)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(w, weights, atol=0.001)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(strain[0], truth[60], atol=0.001)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rate[[0, 2]], onset[[60, 62]], atol=0.001)
    assert abs(rate[1] - onset[61]) > 0.05
    C_prior, R_prior, _, _ = hereditary_creep_design(p[~fit], h[~fit], dt, time, x[~fit], tau)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rate[1:], (R_prior @ w)[1:], atol=1e-12)
    innovation = measured[60] - (R_prior @ w)[0]
    np.testing.assert_allclose(strain[0] - (C_prior @ w + e0[~fit, None])[0],
                               innovation * time, atol=1e-12)

    # Same experiment in different stress and time units, and a different
    # positive affine gauge for every reference/feature group.
    sf, tf = 0.01, 0.5
    p2, h2, x2, m2 = calibrate_creep_inputs(sf * command_p, sf * command_h, group, stratum,
        (a + 1) * raw - b, (a + 1) * panel - b, cg, sf * cx, sf * cy, sf * 3.0)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(p2, sf * p, atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(h2, sf * h, atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(x2, x, atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(m2, missing)
    rescaled = fit_predict_hereditary_creep(p2, h2, tf * dt, tf * time, x2, m2, e0, obs,
        measured / tf, fit, sf * 3.0, (0.03, 1.5), 0.02, 0.015 / tf)
    assert all(np.all(np.isfinite(q)) for q in rescaled)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rescaled[0] / tf, tau, rtol=1e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rescaled[1] * np.r_[sf, sf, np.repeat(tf, 5)], w, atol=1e-7)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rescaled[2], strain, atol=1e-7)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rescaled[3] * tf, rate, atol=1e-7)


run_self_test()
